about: S-131 review summary eval: reviews → English and French summaries with themes (ReviewSummaryEval). Passes when both languages are present, every `mustInclude` group appears in the English summary or themes, and nothing in `mustNotInclude` does (reviewer names, invented praise or prices). `input` is a phrase from the first review the simulated model matches on.

reviews: Explained everything clearly and was on time.
On time, fair, explained the options.
Good work but took longer than quoted.

en.summary: Customers praise clear explanations and on-time visits. One mentions a job that took longer than quoted.

fr.summary: Les clients apprécient les explications claires et la ponctualité. Un client note un travail plus long que prévu.

reviews: Broth was rich and the portion big.
Fresh, a bit late on delivery.
Best broth, hot when it arrived.

en.summary: Customers love the rich broth and generous portions. One delivery arrived a bit late.

fr.summary: Les clients adorent le bouillon riche et les portions généreuses. Une livraison est arrivée un peu en retard.

reviews: Wrong size sent, return was easy though.

en.summary: Most customers got exactly what they ordered, packed fast. One received the wrong size, and found the return easy.

fr.summary: La plupart des clients ont reçu exactement leur commande, emballée rapidement. Un client a reçu la mauvaise taille, mais le retour a été facile.
